title: "03 · Workflow orchestration"

When should transitions be explicit in the controller?

## Concepts

Use a state machine to define legal transitions, deterministic routing, branch joins, and terminal states. Add timeouts and checkpoints at operations that may fail independently [@anthropic2024effectiveagents].

## Study task

Draw the experiment controller as a transition table with proposed, scored, kept, discarded, and failed outcomes. Decide whether scoring can be retried after a lost response.

## Deliverable

Submit a diagram and a transition table with each trigger, state update, and one recovery invariant.
